sources.coverage: Complete 11-row captured BISDN Linux HTML hardware compatibility table; source-scoped listing records, not hardware identity/alias/manufacturer/deployment assertions. Exact Vendor/Platform/ASIC/Architecture/Release cells and download URLs retained. Vendor is a table label, not physical manufacture. No grouped-name or parenthetical alias expansion. No installed OS, unit fitment, stock, entitlement, current support guarantee, retired status or recommendation to flash a device is inferred. Download links were not fetched. Upstream rights retained; local research only.
